dogecoin.text: Dogecoin is the only cryptocurrency I’ve purchased because it’s a direct satire of the ridiculousness, wastefulness, and absurdity of “real” cryptocurrencies and all of the fanboy “investors” who simply want to word to operate like a casino. May the Doge be with you

@maxkeiser I’m not next, because I don’t have any Bitcoin. I only own Dogecoin as a deliberate satire of the absurdity, wastefulness, social ill and volatility of cryptocurrencies so that it never becomes more than a way for bros to gamble.
